lead.title: DeepSeek developing its own AI inference chip to reduce reliance on NVIDIA and Huawei
lead.summary: The Chinese AI startup is building a custom inference chip, marking a strategic pivot from software-only innovation to full-stack hardware sovereignty. The move, reported by Bloomberg via Reuters, signals deepening vertical integration across the industry as firms seek alternatives to dominant GPU suppliers.

top_stories.title: Meta launches Muse Image and Muse Video — free AI generation with native audio
top_stories.summary: Meta released Muse Image, a free AI image generator available in Meta AI, Instagram Stories, and WhatsApp with prompt-based editing and Marketplace integration, alongside Muse Video which delivers high visual fidelity with native audio support.

top_stories.title: Norm AI raises $120M Series C at $1.2B valuation for legal AI platform
top_stories.summary: Khosla Ventures led the round for Norm AI, an AI-native law firm building supervised AI agents for legal work. Bain, Craft Ventures, Coatue, and Vanguard also participated, marking one of the largest legal AI rounds to date.

top_stories.title: LLM verifiers emerge as a new scaling axis: continuous scoring without fine-tuning
top_stories.summary: A Stanford, NVIDIA, and UC Berkeley paper demonstrates extracting calibrated scores from LLM scoring-token logits, achieving 86.5% on Terminal-Bench V2 without fine-tuning, establishing verification as a new scaling axis alongside pre-training and test-time compute.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA compresses hybrid MoE into Puzzle-75B-A9B, doubling inference throughput
top_stories.summary: NVIDIA's joint structural search compresses Nemotron-3-Super into Puzzle-75B-A9B, roughly doubling server throughput on 8xB200 nodes and improving H100 concurrency from 1 to 8 requests at 1M-token context.

items.title: GigaWorld-1: roadmap to build world models for robot policy evaluation
items.summary: A systematic study of 7 video world models with WMBench benchmark (324K+ simulated rollouts) finds evaluator quality is dominated by long-horizon action consistency, not short-term visual realism.

items.title: EdgeBench: agent real-world learning follows log-sigmoid scaling laws
items.summary: First evidence that agent real-world learning follows a log-sigmoid scaling law (R²=0.998) across 134 tasks and 38K hours of interaction. Agent learning speed doubles every 3 months.

items.title: OmniOpt: comprehensive taxonomy and benchmarking of modern deep learning optimizers
items.summary: A 91-page survey taxonomy and geometric analysis of modern optimizers (Adam, Lion, Sophia, etc.) with standardized evaluation across multiple tasks.

items.title: MANCE: manifold-aware concept erasure preserves unrelated information
items.summary: Proposes the Manifold Constraint Hypothesis — constraining concept removal to the natural representation manifold better preserves unrelated data, achieving SOTA across 119 settings spanning text and vision models.

items.title: KVpop: predictive online pruning for key-value cache compression
items.summary: An online KV cache pruning method that predicts which attention keys and values to drop during LLM inference, reducing memory usage while maintaining generation quality.

items.title: AI market pivots from token-subsidized experimentation to token scarcity
items.summary: June 2026 marks a fundamental shift as enterprises move from subsidized AI experimentation to token scarcity, forcing cost and efficiency prioritization. Fable 5 launch and new US export controls on AI models intensify the debate.

items.title: OpenAI proposes transferring 5% stake to US sovereign fund
items.summary: OpenAI's proposal to transfer a 5% equity stake to a US sovereign fund sparks political debate over corporate-government AI ties. KPMG and Box studies show AI adoption correlates with headcount growth.

items.title: DeepSeek publishes new AI speed optimization paper
items.summary: DeepSeek released a new research paper (arXiv 2607.05147) detailing a novel speed optimization technique for AI inference, promising significant performance improvements.

items.title: China expects humanoid robot output to exceed 100,000 units this year
items.summary: Senior official Gan Xiaobin announced the projection at a press conference for the upcoming WAIC in Shanghai, highlighting China's booming robotics industry powered by evolving AI applications.

items.title: UMA unveils first humanoid robot design with real-time learning architecture
items.summary: At the Machina Summit in Paris, Physical AI company UMA introduced a new architecture enabling robots to learn skills through demonstration rather than manual programming, targeting factories, warehouses, and logistics centers.

items.title: Hyundai showcases Atlas humanoid robot at FIFA World Cup
items.summary: Hyundai's Atlas humanoid robot handed the game ball to the referee during the Brazil-Norway match, demonstrating advanced bipedal locomotion and manipulation in a high-visibility public setting.

items.title: ABB Robotics launches Flexley Stack F712 autonomous forklift with vSLAM
items.summary: The autonomous forklift features visual SLAM navigation eliminating the need for pre-installed infrastructure, handling loads up to 2,000 kg with ±10 mm positional accuracy.

items.title: Notion launches dedicated iOS app for chatting with AI agents
items.summary: Notion Agents brings custom AI agents and connected models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to a single iOS app, supporting text, photos, and voice notes.

items.title: LinkedIn launches generative AI job search for Premium subscribers
items.summary: The new tool lets users describe their ideal role in natural language instead of using restrictive filters, powered by generative AI.

items.title: Ternlight ships 7 MB embedding model in browser via WASM
items.summary: An open-source ternary-quantized embedding model distilled from MiniLM, shipping in Rust/WASM SIMD at just 7 MB for on-device semantic search with no API dependencies.

items.title: Savi Security launches app to protect consumers from AI-generated scams
items.summary: Backed by $7M in seed funding from Acrew Capital, Savi protects against AI-generated scams via text, email, and phone calls including realistic kidnapping ransom demands.

items.title: Katalyst launches AI sales agent for Salesforce pipeline management
items.summary: The AI agent automatically summarizes calls, updates Salesforce records, drafts follow-ups, and surfaces deal signals for enterprise sales teams.

items.title: Monogram raises $40M seed for visual AI interface
items.summary: DST Global and Lux Capital led the round for a visual and voice-driven AI app that generates interactive UIs from natural language queries, founded by Coursera co-founder Eren Bali.

items.title: Agave raises $15M Series A to bring AI to construction financials
items.summary: Accel led the round for Agave's AI platform handling budgeting, invoicing, and lien releases across 80,000+ projects representing $100B+ in construction volume.

items.title: Luffy AI secures £8.1M Series A for neuroplastic industrial AI control
items.summary: BGF led the round for Luffy's neuroplastic AI platform providing real-time adaptive control for motors, robotics, and drones using sparse neural networks trained in simulation.

items.title: ARC Intelligence raises €4M seed for AI-native finance OS
items.summary: 42CAP led the round for ARC's AI-native Finance OS connecting ERP and CRM systems, having already supported 200,000+ business decisions.
